# MIKATA — 世界のミカタ
> AIが各国メディアの論調を分析し、独自解説+ソースリンクで多視点ニュースを日本語提供するサービス

## About
MIKATA is a multi-perspective news platform that uses AI to analyze how different countries' media cover the same story. We provide original 800-1200 character analysis in Japanese, along with source links and sentiment labels (positive/negative/neutral) for each country's perspective.

## Topics
- Sports (soccer, baseball, basketball, etc.)
- Economy & Markets (stocks, forex, crypto, etc.)
- Gaming & Esports

- Homepage: https://mikata.media/

## Content Model
Each article contains:
1. Original AI analysis (800-1200 chars) — the "primary" work under copyright law
2. Multi-country perspective links (80-char summaries + links) — the "secondary/citation" component
3. Sentiment analysis: positive/negative/neutral ratio per source country

## Robots Policy
All AI bots (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot) are allowed to crawl this site. See /robots.txt for details.
